source: One account's Weekly window read two ways (#1953): the /usage answer as the pinned SDK declares it (utilization a percentage, 0-100, resets_at an ISO instant) and the run's rate_limit_event as the bundled 0.3.289 CLI builds it, its utilization the anthropic-ratelimit-unified-7d-utilization header unchanged (a fraction: the CLI shows it as floor(utilization * 100) percent and warns at 0.75 and 0.95) and resetsAt epoch seconds. Values from the 0.1.10 release QA: Weekly read 86% resetting 2026-10-11T21:59:59.702Z, the run's verdict resetting 22:00:00Z.
